concerns.text: T019 (US2 Implementation) depends on T014 (Serialization/Checksums) which is marked incomplete. T019 consumes network instances saved by T014. Since T014 is not complete, T019 cannot execute. The task order implies US2 can start, but the producer (T014) is missing.

T033 (Sensitivity Analysis) depends on T023 (Write Raw Simulation Results) to re-analyze existing traces. T023 is marked incomplete. T033 cannot run until T023 produces the HDF5 files. The current ordering lists T033 in Phase 6, but the dependency on an incomplete Phase 4 task creates a blocking gap.

T016a (Data Schema Prep) is marked complete, but T032b (Data Population) is incomplete. T032b populates the schema defined in T016a. While T016a is a schema definition, the dependency chain for US3 (T028-T032) relies on the *existence* of the populated data (T032b) to run regression. The current status implies the schema is ready but the data pipeline is broken, blocking US3 execution.

T008 (Setup pytest/contract framework) is marked incomplete and explicitly depends on T007 (Base data schemas). T007 is marked complete. However, T008 is a foundational task required for testing US1 (T009-T011). The plan states 'No user story work can begin until this phase is complete', yet US1 implementation tasks (T012-T015) are listed as if they can proceed while T008 is incomplete. This violates the 'Foundational tasks first' rule.

Phase 7 tasks (T035-T043) are marked [P] (parallel-safe). However, T043 (Run Reference-Validator) depends on the completion of T035-T042 (which introduce new citations). T043 cannot run in parallel with T035-T042; it must follow them. The [P] tag on T043 is incorrect.
